title: AI Outbound Calls: Let an AI Voice Agent Call Your Contacts | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
An AI voice agent can call your contacts, ask its questions, leave a message and hand a warm customer to a person. An AI call is not a dialer mode: it is an automated activity with a contact, a subject and an AI profile. This video shows how to set it up in the CrestApps Contact Center for Orchard Core, what the agent does before, during and after the call, and where you review the conversation.

In this video:
• Why an AI call is not a dialer mode, and Telnyx only
• The AI profile from a phone template
• The subject: live agent handoff and dispositions the AI can choose
• The automatic load: profile, channel and address
• Screening before each call
• Voicemail, silence, reconnect, handoff and the recording disclosure
• Review AI conversation
